description:
Just-in-time Entra and Azure PIM role activation from the system tray

Elevate is a system-tray app for Microsoft Entra Privileged Identity Management. Sign in with
one or more Entra accounts, see the Entra directory roles, Azure resource roles and PIM-for-Groups
memberships you are eligible for across tenants, and activate them with a duration and reason,
extend, deactivate, or cancel a pending request. Countdowns and expiry toasts keep track of what
is active. Sign in with your own app registration through the Windows account picker, or with
the Azure CLI or Azure PowerShell app for Azure resource roles.
